entries.clue: Oak-panelled sweep under an iron and glass dome, the first-class showpiece
To descend by sliding down a doubled rope under control
Distress letters the operators tapped out alongside the older call CQD
Flat bone that slides over the front of a bent leg.
Great trunk vessel that carries blood away from the heart.
Drifting mountain calved off a Greenland glacier, sighted with no time to spare
Coarse speckled rock giving rough, grippy holds on Dartmoor's weathered tors
Snail-shaped coil deep in the ear that senses sound.
Shinbone: the thicker of the two bones in the lower leg.
Loose slope of broken stone that slides underfoot
Spring-loaded device that grips a crack when the trigger is let go
Signalling code of dots and dashes, flashed by lamp as well as tapped
